snippet.title: Tilescapes - Open Beta Trailer
snippet.description:
After what felt like four months, Beta 1.0 of my turn-based simulation sandbox game Tilescapes has finally released! You can play it FOR FREE here:

https://boiaaang.itch.io/tilescapes

If you're a returning player, there were a LOT of changes and additions made in this update coming from the previous one. If you're so inclined, you can feel free to view the patch notes here:

https://boiaaang.itch.io/tilescapes/devlog/937962/patch-notes-tilescapes-beta-10

MUSIC BY PNOX: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nOQa9-hX4AQ
Used with permission.

Thank you!
https://boiaaang-depths.weebly.com/
